text:
lin: Quick UX sweep for Compliance > Storage settings — three tiny but caught-in-review nits: encryption label, retention unit display, and tab order for region select.
noah: can you paste the current strings/screens?
lin: badge reads 'Encrypted (KMS)'. tooltip is long: 'Data encrypted using customer-managed Key Management Service (KMS). See docs for rotation and access.' wraps weird on narrow screens.
tara: SR/readout tip: avoid parentheses in compact labels. Reads better as 'Encryption: customer key' or 'Encrypted — customer key'. Keep 'KMS' only in the docs page.
lin: contrast check: badge color ratio ~2.7:1. Need darker fill or dark text + border. Also it's a span, not keyboard-focusable.
noah: easy fixes: make it a <button> with aria-describedby and a short aria-label 'Encryption: customer-managed key. Press enter for details'.
lin: retention input shows just '90' — logs say 'Retention set to 90' which confused compliance folks. Recommend showing units inline ("90 days") and making audit text explicit.
tara: another accessibility gotcha: visual order is Region then Retention, but DOM tab order goes retention -> region. Found during keyboard walkthrough.
ops-bot: Reminder: small UI changes need regression test. Create a minimal e2e verifying tab order, SR announcement for the badge, contrast token, and audit log wording.
noah: plan: swap DOM order to match visual layout, implement button badge with short copy 'Encrypted — customer key', darken to #005a3d for contrast, show 'days' suffix in retention UI, and update audit message template.
lin: appreciated. I'll review PR tomorrow after staging deploy.
